text:
Type: geometric patterned cushion
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: woven jacquard fabric with a fine graphic weave
Colors: off-white, black, charcoal grey
Shape: square cushion with a dense lattice of tiny diamond motifs forming larger soft circles, optical op-art effect, plain edges, medium size
Feel: graphic, crisp, lively, cozy
Goes with: grey, black or white sofas, wood, monochrome textiles; contemporary, Scandinavian or modern living rooms
